name: Hue Lighting Control

versions.changelog:
## Device picker for profile filters

Profiles can now target devices by picking them from a list instead of hunting for Device IDs in the server log. "Add Device ID" in the profile editor's Filters tab shows every device that has signed in to your server, labelled with its name, app, the IP it is currently connected from, the last user, and when it was last seen. Devices already in the profile are hidden, manual entry remains available underneath, and saved IDs are shown with their resolved device name.

Remember that each app and each browser on the same physical device has its own ID, so add every one that should trigger the profile.

## Fixes

- Cancelling a profile edit no longer drops device IDs you removed during the edit.
- Bridge names, profile names, and filter values are HTML-escaped when rendered in the config page.
- Duplicate device ID checks are case-insensitive, matching the server-side filter.

## Housekeeping

- The plugin repository manifest now advertises the correct minimum Jellyfin version for every past release: v1.3.0.0 through v2.2.0.0 require 10.11, v1.2.0.0 and earlier run on 10.9 and 10.10.
- CI moved to current GitHub action majors and pins the .NET 10 SDK band.

Requires **Jellyfin 12.0+**. Jellyfin 10.11 users stay on v2.2.0.0.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ericecook/JellyfinHuePlugin/compare/v3.0.0.0...v3.1.0.0

## Jellyfin 12.0 support

This release targets **Jellyfin 12.0+** (.NET 10). Plugins built for Jellyfin 10.11 do not load on 12.0, so this rebuild is required after upgrading your server.

**Jellyfin 10.11 users:** stay on v2.2.0.0. The plugin catalog will keep offering that version to 10.11 servers and will not offer v3.0.0.0 until you upgrade Jellyfin.

No functional changes to lighting behaviour in this release.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ericecook/JellyfinHuePlugin/compare/v2.2.0.0...v3.0.0.0

### Multi-Bridge Support
- Support for multiple Hue bridges with independent configuration
- Per-profile bridge assignment — each lighting profile targets a specific bridge
- Bridge CRUD API endpoints for add, edit, and delete
- Automatic migration from single-bridge to multi-bridge configuration

### New Config UI
- Redesigned configuration page with card-based layout
- Profile templates (Movie Theater, TV Viewing, Bedroom Casual, Gaming Setup) for quick setup
- Edit Bridge modal — click any bridge card to modify its name, IP, or API key
- Click-outside-to-close for all modals
- Auto-save on modal save, profile-reorder, etc. (no more global Save button)
- Improved bridge authentication instructions

### Pause Grace Period
- Configurable grace period to skip pause lighting during the first N seconds of playback
- Useful for skipping pause actions while getting settled at the start of a movie

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Fixed concurrency bugs in playback session management
- Added comprehensive test coverage
- Fixed long Device IDs overflowing their container
- Replaced IntroSkipper DB hack with Jellyfin Media Segments API (from v1.4.0)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ericecook/JellyfinHuePlugin/compare/v1.4.0.0...v2.0.0.0
